title: One smooth hypersurface slice at a separable closed fibre point
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $x\in X$ map to $s\in S$, with $x$ closed in the scheme-theoretic fibre $X_s$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Assume that $\kappa(x)/\kappa(s)$ is finite (finite-dimensional as a vector space) and separable algebraic [def-weil-residue-field, def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], and that $\dim_x(X_s)=d$ for an integer $d\geq1$, with dimension at a point as in [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point]. Then there exist an affine open neighbourhood $U\subseteq X$ of $x$ [def-weil-open-immersion] and an effective Cartier divisor $D\hookrightarrow U$ [def-trf-effective-cartier-center, def-weil-closed-immersion] containing $x$, such that the composite $D\to U\to X\to S$ is smooth and $\dim_x(D_s)=d-1$. Here $x$ in $D$ denotes the unique point mapping to the specified $x\in U$.

source.place: Tag 057F, lemma-slice-smooth-once-separable-residue-field-extension, specialized to a closed fibre point of positive dimension; Tag 057C, lemma-slice-smooth-given-element, proof, displayed dimension drop for the chosen hypersurface.
